advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Skip local tickets that carry neither 'ticket_id' nor 'id' rather than bucketing them under the '' key where they collide/mismatch.
evidence: src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/snapshot_lagfree_refresh.py:158: `t.get("ticket_id", t.get("id", "")): t`
A ticket with neither key collapses to key '' and the dict-comprehension keeps only the last such ticket; local_by_id.get(local_id) then returns None for real ids or the wrong ticket for local_id==''
advisory.finding: local_by_id is keyed by t.get('ticket_id', t.get('id', '')); any local ticket dict lacking BOTH 'ticket_id' and 'id' is stored under the empty-string key ''. Multiple such tickets overwrite one another, and a binding whose local_id happens to be '' (or any lookup that misses) can silently associate with the wrong local ticket, skewing the local==baseline ambiguity test.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Bound or batch the unscoped ambiguous-key direct-GET volume (cap the candidate set or use a batch fetch) so an index-lag / mass-edit burst cannot fan out into O(N-bindings) serial REST GETs per unscoped pass.
evidence: refresh_scoped_snapshot: `else: jira_keys = _unscoped_ambiguous_jira_keys(ctx, binding_store, curr_snapshot)` then `overlay_lagfree_scalars(curr_snapshot, jira_keys, client)` (lines 131-134)
overlay_lagfree_scalars issues one remote call per key in a serial loop: `for jira_key in jira_keys: ... fresh_fields = _safe_get_issue(client, jira_key)` (snapshot_lagfree_refresh.py:94-98)
get_issue_by_rest is a single-key REST round-trip: `issue = _call_logged("get_issue_by_rest", remote_id, lambda: self._client.issue(remote_id))` (adapters/jira_datacenter/_issues.py:216)

_unscoped_ambiguous_jira_keys iterates the FULL confirmed-binding population, not a pass working set: `for local_id, entry in all_bindings().items():` (snapshot_lagfree_refresh.py:163); all_bindings returns the whole {local_id: entry} map (binding_store.py:234)

ABSENCE: the candidate filter (local==baseline AND remote!=baseline) has no numeric cap/batching — under index lag or bulk remote edits the risk set is not intrinsically small, so per-pass GET count scales with binding count rather than a fixed bound. The prior unscoped path early-returned and issued zero GETs.
advisory.finding: Extending refresh to unscoped passes feeds a data-dependent candidate set into a serial, one-remote-GET-per-key overlay loop; the 'bounded to ambiguous risk set' guarantee degrades to O(N) synchronous REST round-trips when many bound tickets satisfy local==baseline AND stale-snapshot!=baseline (index-lag burst or mass remote edit).
scenarios: A full unscoped production pass runs shortly after a bulk remote edit or during a DC Lucene reindex lag window, so many confirmed bindings show snapshot!=baseline while local==baseline
Large trackers where the confirmed-binding population is large relative to any single pass's normal working set

blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Emit a diagnostic (or otherwise signal) when the unscoped ambiguous-key guard cannot run because all_bindings/get_baseline/inbound mapper is unavailable, so a wiring gap is not silently indistinguishable from 'no clobber risk'.
evidence: src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/snapshot_lagfree_refresh.py:155: `if all_bindings is None or get_baseline is None or inbound_mapper is None:` then `return []`
reconcile.py:133 `runtime_backend: Any = None` — the attribute defaults to None and is set later (reconcile_helpers.py:334), so an unwired/partial ctx yields inbound_mapper=None
ABSENCE: no log/warning/RECON diagnostic distinguishes 'guard prerequisites unavailable' from 'checked and no ambiguous keys' — the clobber guard reports success by producing nothing in both worlds
blocking.finding: _unscoped_ambiguous_jira_keys silently returns [] when all_bindings, get_baseline, or the inbound mapper (ctx.runtime_backend.inbound) is missing/None. In an unscoped production pass this means the entire stale-inbound-clobber protection this change adds silently never runs, and 'the machinery was unavailable' is indistinguishable from 'no ambiguous keys found' (both produce an empty refresh set with no signal). ctx.runtime_backend defaults to None on _PassContext and is only populated later in reconcile_helpers, so a wiring gap/regression fails open with no diagnostic.
